description: Update the account's GLOBAL player (dashboard page Player): controls, colors, theme, caption color/background/size, resume from last position, gear-menu items, menu language and time display. Applies to every video WITHOUT a player profile — including videos uploaded later (they are born without a profile). Send only what changes; the rest is kept. Speed, autoplay and VSL options are NOT global: they live in each video's profile (panda_update_profile / panda_action_configure_folder_profile). Panda branding is not changed here (Settings → Panda Partner). Returns the saved config.

captionsSize.description: Caption font size by the dashboard name: extra_small (10px), small (12px), normal (14px, default), large (16px), extra_large (18px). Use the user's word ('legenda grande' / 'large captions' → large).

controls.description: COMPLETE list of player controls (replaces the current one)

defaultLanguage.description: Language of the player menus (auto = viewer's browser)

saveProgress.description: Resume from where the viewer stopped (continuar de onde parou)

settingsControls.description: Show/hide items of the gear (settings) menu — send only the items that change. With the captions button on, caption language stays on; all items off removes the settings button; turning one on brings it back.

timeDisplayType.description: Time shown in the control bar: current, remaining, or current/total

name: panda_update_player_config
title: Update Player Config
